newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open firmer, await rate news.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open firmer, await rate news.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened firmer on Tuesday following a 108-point rebound Monday, with traders awaiting the outcome of this afternoon's Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up 25.78 to 7829.14 points.
The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), the policy arm of the U.S. Federal Reserve, meets at 1300 GMT on Tuesday and its decision on interest rates is due at about 1815 GMT.
U.S. economists forecast no change in rates for now as recent data suggest growth is moderate and inflation steady.
